en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. Dense rows of houses with steep roofs fill the foreground, with factory chimneys and smoke visible among them. Farther back are scattered villas, fields, and wooded hills. A tall church with a pointed spire stands prominently on the right side. In the sky area at the top left, red printed text reads "Sebnitz i. Sa." suggesting the postcard's title.
